title: Senior Director, Revenue Analytics
description:
LeadVenture is looking for a Senior Director, Revenue Analytics & Planning to join our team. This position will report directly to the CRO. This role owns forecast methodology, capacity and quota planning, compensation modeling, conversion and productivity metrics, and annual planning, and serves as a strategic advisor to the CRO on board-level reporting.
LeadVenture is the leading digital platform provider for powersports, RV, marine, trailer, agriculture, and automotive dealers across North America. Our portfolio of brands, including Dealer Spike, InteractRV, Net Driven, Firestorm, and Frazer, provides dealers with website platforms, digital marketing services, and subscription software products that drive traffic, generate leads, and grow revenue.
We are a private equity-backed company in active growth mode, expanding our software and subscription product footprint across an existing customer base of thousands of dealers. Operating multiple brands, multiple products, and multiple sales motions simultaneously is our defining operational challenge - and our biggest opportunity.
The Opportunity
As LeadVenture scales across multiple brands, products, and sales motions, the opportunity is to bring them together under one trusted framework for how we forecast, plan, and model the business - so leadership can make faster, better-informed decisions.
The Senior Director of Revenue Analytics & Planning owns that framework. You will set the methodology behind our forecast, capacity, quota, and compensation models, define the conversion and productivity metrics the business runs on, and lead annual planning from the revenue side. You will be a strategic partner to the CRO and the analytical conscience of the GTM organization: when a number goes in front of leadership or the Board, you are the reason it can be trusted.
This is a senior pillar leadership seat in Revenue Operations, reporting to the Chief Revenue Operations. You will lead the Revenue Analytics & Planning team, so your time goes to judgment, design, and insight, not data pulls.
What You'll OwnForecast Methodology

• Own the forecast methodology across brands, products, and sales motions - how we call the number, how we weight pipeline, and how we measure and improve accuracy

• Run forecast accuracy reviews; diagnose misses by brand, segment, and rep and drive the fixes

• Partner with FP&A to keep the GTM forecast and the financial plan reconciled to one number

Capacity & Quota Planning

• Build and own the capacity model: headcount, ramp, productivity, attrition, and coverage assumptions that translate a bookings target into a hiring and pipeline plan

• Own quota-setting methodology and territory/segment allocation; make sure quotas are achievable, defensible, and tied to the plan

Compensation Modeling

• Model sales compensation plans - cost of sales, payout curves, accelerators, and scenario analysis - and recommend plan design to leadership

• Monitor plan performance in-year: attainment distribution, payout vs. budget, and unintended behavior

Funnel, Conversion & Productivity Metrics

• Define and govern the core GTM metrics: stage conversion, velocity, win rate, opportunity creation, pipeline coverage, and rep productivity

• Establish benchmarks and targets by brand and motion; surface where the funnel is leaking and what it costs

• Own the Math of the Business - the model that connects activity, pipeline, and bookings to the revenue target

Annual & Operating Planning

• Lead the revenue side of annual planning: targets, capacity, quota, comp, and pipeline requirements

• Build scenario models leadership can use to make trade-off decisions quickly

Executive & Board Insight

• Act as a strategic advisor to the CRO and CEO - turn analysis into clear recommendations and the so-what, not just the chart

• Own the analytical foundation for monthly board reporting and forecast commentary, and present directly to executive leadership as needed

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

• Fully remote position with flexibility to work from anywhere, with an ideal focus in South Carolina or the Charlotte region.

• Join a growing, entrepreneurial real estate law practice with a collaborative, supportive culture.

• Handle sophisticated residential real estate transactions with autonomy and meaningful responsibility.

• Work with a high-performing team serving national clients, builders, lenders, investors, and homebuyers.

• Annual performance bonus opportunity.

• Excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, 401(k) with company match, and generous PTO.

• Strong opportunity for long-term professional growth and advancement.

Location:
This is a fully remote position. Candidates may be located anywhere, with South Carolina and the Charlotte, NC area preferred. Occasional in-person closings or client meetings may be required.
Note :
Applicants must be licensed to practice law in South Carolina and have at least 2 years of residential real estate/title law experience with the ability to independently manage transactions.
About Us
We are a fast-growing, client-focused real estate law practice dedicated to delivering exceptional title and closing services. Our team values collaboration, accountability, innovation, and outstanding client service while creating an environment where attorneys can thrive professionally and personally. Confidential Employer.
Job Description

• Review and examine residential real estate titles from initial search through closing.

• Identify, analyze, and resolve title defects and curative issues.

• Prepare preliminary and final title opinions.

• Draft and review deeds, affidavits, powers of attorney, estate documents, releases, and other legal instruments.

• Advise clients, lenders, title companies, real estate agents, and internal team members on title-related legal matters.

• Review restrictive covenants, HOA documents, recorded instruments, and underwriting requirements.

• Ensure compliance with applicable state laws and title insurance guidelines.

• Manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and exceptional client service.

• Sign Final Title Opinions and other required attorney certifications.

• Collaborate closely with processors, paralegals, and closing attorneys to move transactions efficiently through closing.

Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.

• Active South Carolina Bar license required.

• 2+ years of residential real estate/title law experience.

• Experience handling title review, title opinions, and curative matters.

• Currently or previously approved by multiple title insurance companies preferred.

• Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and client service skills.

• Notary Public or willingness to obtain before starting.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Why You Will Love Working Here
Our team believes in empowering attorneys with autonomy while providing the support needed to succeed. You'll enjoy meaningful work, a collaborative culture, excellent leadership, strong benefits, performance bonuses, and opportunities to grow alongside an expanding practice that values quality, integrity, and exceptional client service.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

title: Growth Lead
description:
We are looking for a Growth Lead to work with us remotely.
About Us
Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.
The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact.
Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.
Your role
As Growth Lead, you lead and manage the full acquisition process for Evaluators in Japan. Your mandate is to design, test, and scale acquisition channels by blending global brand positioning with strong local adaptation across Japanese platforms, digital culture, and community engagement practices. You will combine strategic planning with hands-on execution: building local playbooks, running campaigns, owning key growth metrics. This role operates in a matrix reporting to both the local and global teams.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Local Growth Strategy & Planning

• Own the Japan growth strategy for Evaluator acquisition, aligned with profile needs and country targets.

• Localize global playbooks for Japanese platforms, culture, and applicable guidelines, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

• Identify, prioritize, and test new channels (campus programs, communities, influencers, niche platforms).

2. Lead Generation & User Acquisition

• Design and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns (online, offline, social, partnerships).

• Lead social recruiting on LINE, Instagram, TikTok and other relevant local platforms.

• Build and manage university, travel, and auto community programs to source qualified Evaluators.

• Implement direct recruitment campaigns and processes with full autonomy to design and execute strategies.

• Own performance and budget across channels, optimizing for volume, quality, and cost per qualified lead.

3. Funnel Management & Optimization

• Own the acquisition funnel from first touch to qualified Evaluator.

• Diagnose drop-offs in the funnel and partner with Operations and Growth & Engagement teams to adjust targeting, messaging, and incentives.

• Run structured A/B tests (audiences, creatives, offers, sequencing, timing) to improve sign-up and qualification rates.

• Build and maintain clear, simple processes so the funnel can be scaled.

4. Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Define, track, and report on core acquisition KPIs

• Maintain dashboards and campaign reports; turn data into concrete next steps, not just slides.

• Use CRM/marketing tools (Clay, HubSpot, etc.) to structure outreach lists, automations, and follow-ups.

• Build repeatable playbooks and documentation so Japan can scale beyond a single operator.

5. Communication & Collaboration

• Partner closely with the Operations team to ensure a smooth handover from qualified Evaluator to first mission.

• Share funnel insights with Operations (profile quality, channel differences, expectations) to help them optimize activation.

• Develop and execute targeted communication to nurture potential Evaluators through qualification (email, messaging, content).

• Write clear, concise marketing and recruiting materials in English and Japanese.

• Take ownership of projects end-to-end, managing multiple initiatives and stakeholders at once.

Requirements
What you bring along:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or related field (Master’s is a plus).

• 3+ years in growth, recruiting, and community engagement in Japan, with clear examples of owning targets.

• Native-level Japanese and strong business English (written and spoken).

• Hands-on experience in at least two of: University/campus recruiting or Gig/platform or marketplace recruiting

title: Finance Manager, Strategic Finance (FP&A)
description:
About Shippo

At Shippo , our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet. Our mission is to make every merchant successful through excellent shipping, delivering world-class logistics technology and infrastructure. We’re building the backbone of global e-commerce - connecting merchants to carriers worldwide through a single API and intuitive dashboard.

As a remote-first and globally distributed team , we believe flexibility fuels trust, autonomy, and performance. Our diverse perspectives - across continents, cultures, and time zones - drive our innovation and enable us to build solutions used by businesses everywhere. We invest in modern, scalable technology so our teams can build, ship, and iterate with confidence.

Your impact starts here: every person at Shippo plays a direct role in shaping the infrastructure that powers global commerce and makes shipping simpler for businesses around the world.

How we will deliver success together:

As a Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, you will own the financial backbone of Shippo : the full company P&L, the annual operating plan, monthly C-level reporting, and board-level financial materials. This is not a support role. You will be the primary financial operator for a high-growth logistics technology company, accountable for the numbers that the CEO, CFO, and Board rely on.

This role carries meaningful executive exposure. You will report directly to the VP of Strategic Finance and have a skip-level relationship with the CFO, meaning your work will be seen, challenged, and relied upon at the top of the organization. You will produce the quarterly Board of Directors finance addendum, present financials in monthly leadership reviews, and be a trusted voice in the room when the numbers matter most. For the right person, this is a fast path to genuine strategic influence.

You will work directly with the CFO (as your skip level), and partner with Accounting, People Ops, and Engineering, and the full leadership team. The right person for this role is a strong finance operator who thrives on ownership, thinks commercially, and isn't satisfied just reporting the numbers - they want to understand them, improve them, and communicate them to decision-makers who act on them.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

Company P&L & Close Reporting

• Own the full company P&L, revenue through EBITDA, and serve as the primary finance partner to Accounting for the monthly close cycle.

• Produce the monthly MBR (Monthly Business Review), flash report, and supporting financial narrative for senior leadership, translating actuals vs. plan into clear stories and actionable recommendations.

• Collaborate with the Controller to ensure accuracy and alignment on actuals and variances vs. plan.

Annual Operating Plan & Forecasting

• Own the Master P&L model, the company's single source of truth for forecasting, scenario analysis, and AOP. Build, maintain, and evolve it as the business changes.

• Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process across all functions, including headcount planning, cost modeling, and revenue scenario builds.

• Drive 2-3 reforecasts throughout the year, surfacing risks and opportunities before they show up in actuals.

Board & Executive Reporting

• Produce the quarterly Board of Directors Finance Addendum, including financial exhibits, variance analysis, and supplemental data packages reviewed by the CFO and CEO.

• Build the financial models and materials that support executive decision-making on product investment and cost savings strategies.

Transaction Readiness & M&A Support

• Own and maintain Shippo 's transaction readiness infrastructure, auditable P&L and balance sheet flat files, Looker cohort and retention views, AR/AP aging standardization, ensuring the company is 80%+ deal-ready at any given time.

• Serve as the internal financial lead for any M&A diligence process, managing the data room and coordinating with Legal, Accounting, and the CF

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect with deep experience in large-scale production AI inference. You will collaborate with top EMEA AI Natives, AI infrastructure providers, and enterprises deploying AI at scale. You will address the industry's toughest AI inference challenges at the intersection of AI and high-performance computing, driving innovations in areas such as multi-node Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving, interconnect-aware scheduling, memory-bound workload optimization, and next-generation inference architectures. • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, High-Performance Computing, or equivalent professional experience.

• Ability to engage effectively with ML engineers, researchers, and systems architects at a deep technical level.

Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability-working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role
Evolve is on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone, and that starts with the homeowners who trust us with their properties. Signing with Evolve is only the start. Before an owner earns a dollar, their home has to be set up, photographed, permitted, priced and listed - and every one of those steps is a place where owners stall or drop off.
As Principal Product Manager for Activation, you'll own that journey, from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing. You'll be measured on how many owners go live, how quickly, and whether they're still with us six months later - not just on activation volume. The levers are known and largely unowned today: property setup, photo scheduling, permits and compliance, rates, and multi-property onboarding. Your job is to turn them into a roadmap and move the number.
The team
Growth owns Evolve 's owner-acquisition funnel, from first impression through qualified lead and signup, and all of our marketing. This role extends Growth's product work past signup into activation, working side by side with the Onboarding team that runs the process today.
What you’ll do

• Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the product roadmap from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing, with activation rate, time to live and 180-day retained activations as the measures of success

• Find where owners stall - property setup, photo scheduling, permits, rates, multi-property onboarding - and decide what to fix first and how

• Build & Experiment

• Ship product changes that take manual steps out of onboarding, from self-serve setup to automated scheduling and reminders

• Run experiments end to end: write the hypothesis, scope the build, measure the result, make the call

• Own activation instrumentation with analytics, so every step from signup to live can be measured by cohort

• Partnership

• Work closely with Onboarding and Operations, who run the process today, to change the system underneath it rather than adding more manual work

• Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on the onboarding journey and with the Funnel Conversion PM on the handoff at signup

• Talk to owners - single-property and portfolio - and turn what you learn into product decisions

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of product management, with meaningful time owning onboarding, activation or time-to-value

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace or operations-heavy business, ideally on the supply or seller side

• A track record of moving activation, conversion or early retention metrics, with the experiments to show for it

• Experience partnering with operations or field teams to automate manual processes

• Strong SQL and hands-on with product analytics tools like Amplitude - you build your own funnels and cohorts

• Comfortable at the spec level with engineers, and able to take products from discovery through launch and iteration

• AI-native working style - you use tools like Claude or Cursor in your daily work for specs, research synthesis and analysis; this is a baseline here, not a differentiator

• Nice to have: experience with compliance-heavy or regulated onboarding (permits, licensing or credentialing), with vacation rental, real estate, hospitality or property management, and with multi-property or business customers alongside individual ones

title: Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is building the infrastructure for autonomous science: AI systems that design experiments, run them in physical labs, and close the loop across life sciences, chemistry, and materials science. Our platform enables this to operate reliably at scale for external customers who require security, auditability, and operational rigor.

We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval (Enterprise AI) to own how scientists and agents ask questions of scientific knowledge at Lila: published literature and patents, customer-supplied documents, lab protocols, and the structured experimental record.

Your work will involve building RAG over unstructured text and a scientific knowledge graph that links literature to the structured experimental record.

Enterprise customers require one retrieval platform that any scientific workload can build on, with tenancy enforced in the index and the graph rather than the application layer. You will own that stack end to end, from ingestion to retrieval to cited answers a scientist can trace back to the evidence.

This is a deeply technical senior individual contributor role. We move fast, ship often, and look for engineers who do well with ambiguity and enjoy shaping the problem as much as solving it.

What You'll Be Building

• Technical leadership across platform engineering, infrastructure, AI/ML, and scientific teams. Broad architectural influence, high autonomy, direct ownership of critical platform systems.

• Define the shared retrieval foundation. Your architecture decisions become the default for scientific workloads across the company, well beyond the first one you ship.

• Knowledge graph and graph retrieval. Build one scientific knowledge graph from literature and the structured experimental record. Own graph retrieval and its fusion with vector and lexical search into a single cited answer.

• Agentic search. Build the autonomous research loop, from query planning through retrieval to traceable reasoning.

• Retrieval quality. Own the retrieval pipeline end to end and the evaluation harness.

• Ingestion and extraction. Own the pipeline that turns the many types of scientific data (PDFs, patents, lab protocols, and more) into semantically searchable evidence.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 8+ years of software development experience, including production ownership of a search, retrieval, RAG, or knowledge graph system that real users depended on.

• Production experience building semantic search: embedding models, vector indexes (HNSW/IVF), hybrid lexical and vector retrieval, and reranking. Graph database experience is a strong plus.

• Track record in high-growth environments where speed-to-value mattered as much as long-term architecture.

• You can describe how you measured retrieval quality (recall, groundedness, citation accuracy) and how you caught regressions.

• Hands-on coding in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI, async Python).

• Modern cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS).

• Strong cross-functional communication and the ability to influence architecture across teams.

• BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

• Shipped RAG or semantic search in a regulated or enterprise context, through security and compliance review under regimes such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP (including ALCOA+ data integrity), or FedRAMP.

• Permission-aware retrieval over access-controlled data.

• Document understanding at scale: OCR, layout-aware parsing, table and figure extraction from scientific literature.

• Agentic retrieval and GraphRAG patterns, and how to evaluate them.

• Platforms serving scientific or laboratory data such as LIMS, ELN, bioinformatics, or materials informatics, with an understanding of provenance and traceability requirements.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues - they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. title: Graphic Designer Specialist - AI Trainer
description:
Are you an experienced graphic designer eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language and vision models are rapidly evolving, and their ability to understand visual creativity depends on high-quality training data. With your design expertise, tomorrow’s AI can learn to recognize layout principles, evaluate visual hierarchy, interpret color theory, and understand the creative decision-making that drives exceptional design. That training data begins with you-your professional insights will help power the next generation of AI.
We’re looking for a highly skilled graphic design professional with deep experience in visual communication, layout design, color systems, and creative concept development. You’ll collaborate with advanced AI tools, review model-generated design content, and provide expert feedback on accuracy, style, usability, and adherence to design principles across both print and digital formats.
On a typical day, you will analyze AI-generated graphics, evaluate composition and visual reasoning, annotate design errors, assess typography and color usage, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation processes, and design quality guidelines.
Fluency with industry-standard design software is required, including Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Experience with Adobe XD or Figma for UI/UX-related work is valuable, and familiarity with After Effects or Premiere Pro for motion graphics is a plus. Additional skills in social media content creation, video editing, illustration, or photography are also beneficial. Clear communication, strong creative judgment, and meticulous attention to detail are essential.
Ready to channel your graphic design expertise into the technology that will support creatives around the world? Apply today and help train the models that will shape the future of visual design.
We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Product Manager
description:
Job Title:
Product Manager Job Description
We're Concentrix . The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.
The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent .
In our Global Product Organization , you will help shape the next generation of platform services that power our global customer experience ecosystem - from secure identity management to intelligent data products. You will collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and global stakeholders to define product strategy, evolve foundational capabilities, and deliver secure, scalable solutions across identity, data, and shared services.
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Position Summary
As a Product Manager - Platform Services , you will help build the next generation of platform services that power Concentrix ’s global customer experience ecosystem. You will define and drive product strategy for two platform products, shaping roadmaps across identity, data management, and shared services. This role is ideal for a pragmatic, collaborative product professional who can translate complex platform needs into clear priorities and meaningful business outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Define and drive product strategy for two platform products within the identity, data management, and shared services ecosystem.

• Own and evolve the product roadmap and backlog for IAM, data management, and shared services products.

• Define, refine, and prioritize product requirements in partnership with design and engineering teams.

• Collaborate with development teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable platform capabilities.

• Support alignment across products and domains on APIs, data standards, shared tools, and platform practices.

• Advance data governance and internal analytics within the platform ecosystem.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear priorities, user stories, product decisions, and stakeholder communications.

• Partner with global, cross-functional stakeholders to drive outcomes, remove ambiguity, and enable continuous improvement.

Qualifications

• 4-7+ years of product management experience, ideally in a mid- to senior-level product role.

• Solid understanding of platform or data products.

• Experience with CIAM, APIs, or data pipelines is a strong plus.

• Comfortable working with APIs, data models, and cloud-based architectures.

• Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and Jira.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly.

• Experience collaborating with global, cross-functional teams including engineering, design, product, and business stakeholders.

• Curiosity, pragmatism, and a bias for action.

Ability to balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on backlog ownership and delivery execution

The Role
BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. Doit Holdings is our regulated investment platform in Malaysia, applying to the Securities Commission for registration as a Recognized Market Operator running an e-Services Platform.
The Head of Compliance owns compliance for that platform, from the registration application through to the monitoring that keeps it supervisable once live. You will report to the Chief Executive of doit Holdings, with an administrative reporting line to Bjak 's Head of Risk and Compliance.
What You'll Own

• Building and running the compliance framework: the monitoring plan, the registers, and the breach and corrective action process.

• Owning the risk and compliance content of the registration application, including the operational and compliance manuals.

• Supporting the independent validation of controls covering risk, compliance and anti-money laundering, through to completion.

• Maintaining the platform rulebook and running amendments through the SC's review routes.

• Ensuring the anti-money laundering monitoring allocation is recorded in every partner agreement, and that the partner's monitoring is evidenced rather than assumed.

• Owning conflicts of interest, anti-corruption and whistleblowing, and complaints.

• Reviewing onboarding flows, product additions, disclosures and marketing before they ship, and running compliance training across the team.

• A degree or professional qualification from an institution recognised by the government of Malaysia.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in the financial industry, including 3 in a compliance, regulatory or risk role at an SC-licensed or SC-registered entity, or at a BNM-regulated institution.

• At least 2 of those years in capital markets.

• Command of the SC's Guidelines on Recognized Markets, the SC's AML/CFT Guidelines and AMLA 2001, and the Guidelines on Conduct and on Corporate Governance for Capital Market Intermediaries.

• Able to meet the SC's fit and proper criteria.

Nice to have

• SC Licensing Examination Module 11, the International Compliance Association Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance, or CAMS.

• Experience of a Recognized Market Operator registration, or of an SC supervisory review.

• Experience of online distribution and multi-partner fund distribution models.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Bellese is a mission-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare. Our dedication lies in making a meaningful impact on public health outcomes. 
 
Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers. Our goal is to design and build solutions that reduce confusion, provide clarity, support decision making, and streamline the process so that we and our partners can focus on providing better health outcomes by improving patient care and reducing costs and burden.

The Team you will be joining:
HQR
Our team is charged with maintaining and improving the software at the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) that supports the Hospital Quality Reporting program. Thousands of hospitals across the country depend on these systems to submit quality measure data that reflects the care beneficiaries receive in their facility.  Our teams will continuously strive to modernize these systems, while improving them in ways that reduce provider burden and minimize costs to CMS.  We do this through HCD and Service design practices, product thinking, and skilled engineering.  At Bellese, we’re relentlessly focused on enabling and empowering providers to focus on improving the quality and safety of patient care.

Participate in resource planning and recruitment activities to scale the engineering team as necessary.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and positive team culture.
Required Qualifications & Experience: 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a managerial or leadership role.
Demonstrated success in personnel management,
including hiring, performance management, and team building.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), including Agile methodologies.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as databricks, Go, or Python.
Demonstrated experience in managing and leading software engineering teams.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and lead a team.
Strong project management skills with a track record of delivering projects on time.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Northern CA - Local Government)
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are seeking a hardworking, driven individual with superb energy, passion and experience driving new business acquisition in the local government market. This person will join a growing Public Sector Field Sales team and will cover the Northern California, Bay Area territory. The Enterprise Account Executive will play an integral role in developing the territory and will focus on formulating and executing a sales strategy within an assigned territory, resulting in new customer acquisition and revenue growth.

With Verkada’s consistent year over year growth, now is the perfect time to join the sales team. This is an outstanding career option for an enthusiastic sales professional looking to further their career in a fast paced dynamic environment while also being part of a rapidly growing start-up.

This position reports to the Regional Sales Director, California - SLED.

What You'll Do

• Develop and Implement a comprehensive territory plan

• Manage the entire sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics and quota, with a strong emphasis on net new business sales. This includes prospecting and outreach to new local government business opportunities providing product demos, product trials, and strategic negotiations with customers and channel partners

• Meet or exceed individual targets and contribute to the overall team and company success. Proven ability to proactively penetrate new, untapped markets with greenfield accounts and achieve a quarterly quota of at least 1 qualified net new logo

• Initiate and manage expansion discussions to drive customer retention. This includes identifying customers’ goals and requirements, including budgetary constraints and key decision makers

• Devise a comprehensive customer acquisition strategy and partner with Verkada’s channel partner sales organization to establish channel partner initiatives that result in a minimum of 5 deal registrations each quarter

• Drive business growth and enhance market presence through a combination of customer engagements, marketing campaigns, executive briefings, industry conferences, events and market sector knowledge/intelligence 

• Gain an in-depth and detailed understanding of Verkada’s business and products to confidently sell to states, cities, counties, education agencies and special districts within your territory

• Provide account analysis, quarterly business reviews, and accurate revenue forecasts

description:

We’re looking for a Senior Art Director to join the creative team at Plaid and shape how we execute brand awareness campaigns. For more information about the design team, visit https://designedbyplaid.com/.

title: Grant Reviewer, Community Schools (CSII)
description:
Job Title: Grant Reviewer, Community Schools (CSII)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:
Position Summary
Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Community Schools Incentive Initiative (CSII) grant competition. OSSE is seeking reviewers with hands-on experience in community school models and integrated student supports who can evaluate the quality of school-community partnerships and implementation plans.
Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.
Work Schedule
This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

• Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.

• Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.

• Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.

• Approximate completion of reviewer work: June 15, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

• Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.

• Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.

• Assess each application's alignment with community school pillars and the feasibility of its proposed implementation plan.

• Evaluate partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership memoranda of understanding (MOUs), stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and strategies for shared leadership.

• Analyze data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to identified community priorities.

• Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.

• Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.

• Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.

• Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.

• Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.

• Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.

• Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

title: Facility Operator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands

.

ROLE SCOPE

- Serve as the on-site SME for data center critical infrastructure, handling escalations across the white space and the supporting facilities.

- Understand and manage the design limitations and risks of the site, and audit colocation partners and service providers on their maintenance programs and effectiveness.

- Own the change management process for high-risk maintenance activities in the data center.

- Act as first responder on-site for incidents, driving resolution with support from engineering and infrastructure SMEs.

- Partner with colo partners, vendors, and internal teams to keep the site reliable, and feed operational learnings back into design and process.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've operated or led critical-facilities operations in a live data center, owning the physical infrastructure that keeps a site running.

- You know the critical-infrastructure stack (power and cooling) well enough to be the on-site authority and handle escalations.

- You run change management for high-risk work and hold partners to a real maintenance standard.

- You're a calm, capable first responder when something fails at 3am.

- You audit, document, and improve, leaving the site's operating posture stronger than you found it.
